light: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a premium science-fiction tabletop RPG ship-sheet illustration for Galaxies of Legend. A single LIGHT SCOUT CUTTER spacecraft seen in strict orthographic top-down view, nose at top, engines at bottom. Professionally painted realistic hard-surface concept art, intricate layered armor, maintenance hatches, recessed mechanical detail, weathered ceramic and gunmetal surfaces, subtle blue engine glow, small red identification accents. Distinctive sleek utilitarian silhouette, narrow sensor prow, broad habitable middle, two substantial rear engine nacelles, believable purposeful engineering. On a clean white background, full ship visible with generous margins. This is the actual ship-sheet ART, not a simplistic schematic. Integrate twelve blank pale inset rectangular system panels into appropriate places on the painted hull, with crisp empty light interiors for later typesetting: one at sensor nose, two behind it at bridge/navigation and communications, three across forward midbody for life support and facilities, three across middle hull for weapon/cargo/defence systems, three across rear engineering hull for capacitor/engine/FTL. Twelve panels total. Panels must be large, readable, well spaced and follow the ship's architecture without obscuring its recognizable silhouette. Keep exposed richly detailed hull around and between panels. No text, letters, numbers, labels, arrows, tables, page headers, or watermarks. Sophisticated published RPG production art; dimensional painted spacecraft, not SVG, clipart, flat polygons, wireframe, blueprint, or children's drawing. Landscape composition suitable for a landscape letter ship record.
medium: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: premium raster spacecraft illustration for Galaxies of Legend RPG ship sheet. Paint a single MEDIUM FRIGATE in strict orthographic top-down view, nose up, engines down, on clean white background, full spacecraft visible with generous margins, landscape image. Professional realistic hard-surface sci-fi concept art, sophisticated believable engineering, armored command prow, long substantial central hull, distinctive swept side sponsons, four rear engine assemblies, layered weathered ceramic and gunmetal armor, recessed machinery, subtle blue engine glow, restrained red identification marks. This must look like a beautiful published RPG spacecraft illustration, richly dimensional, detailed and purposeful. Integrate exactly SIXTEEN blank pale rectangular inset system panels as usable writing spaces, architecturally distributed through the ship: one forward sensor panel, two bridge and communications panels behind it, four across forward habitable hull, four across central mission hull, four across rear engineering hull, and one engine panel between the rear drives. Crisp blank panel interiors, well spaced, exposed painted armor and intricate mechanical detail around and between panels. Shape the hull around these functional areas with a compelling frigate silhouette, larger and more militarized than a scout cutter. No text, typography, labels, numerals, arrows, tables, watermark. Avoid vector art, SVG look, flat polygons, blueprint, wireframe, clipart, simplistic schematic or children's drawing.
